name: lipoprotein lipase

function.text: LPL encodes lipoprotein lipase. Annotated molecular activities include glycerophospholipase activity and lipoprotein lipase activity. It participates in cholesterol homeostasis and chylomicron remodeling.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to familial lipoprotein lipase deficiency (autosomal recessive).

function.text: LPL encodes lipoprotein lipase. It is a key enzyme in triglyceride metabolism. It catalyzes the hydrolysis of triglycerides from circulating chylomicrons and very low density lipoproteins (VLDL), and thereby plays an important role in lipid clearance from the blood stream, lipid utilization and storage. Although it has both phospholipase and triglyceride lipase activities it is primarily a triglyceride lipase with low but detectable phospholipase activity.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with familial lipoprotein lipase deficiency (autosomal recessive).
